maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is mainly IoT telematics/asset-tracking SaaS subscriptions and new hardware for fleets and industrial vehicles, not repair or maintenance.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private fleets, logistics, and industrial businesses buying telematics and asset-tracking (Unity, Fleet, Cellocator); not government-paid.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its SaaS platform; acquisitions (Pointer, MiX Telematics) are a few large deals, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Embedded telematics devices and SaaS integrated into fleet and forklift operations; switching means hardware replacement, retraining, and workflow disruption.
